preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each reported student p_i is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list contains exactly n elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= result[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list is a student number between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] == find_second_hole_student(i + 1, p) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element in the output list correctly identifies the student who would receive the second hole if student i+1 was the first caught.
